Hello — I'm Priya, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Glad to meet you.

Briefly, what I can do:
- Web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (so you can write and call me there) and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help with captchas or phone checks.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
